primitives.name: Privacy-Preserved Event Logging
primitives.verbatim_quote: # NEXT-001: PostHog privacy-first web analytics baseline ## Repo(s) PostHog ## Category Measurement ## Goal Implement or design the posthog privacy-first web analytics baseline capability for GSE / GSN without touching production data first.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'E': 'Event identifier (dimensionless)', 'T': 'Timestamp (seconds since Unix epoch)', 'P': 'User pseudonym (dimensionless)', 'F': 'Feature flag state (boolean)'}
primitives.assumptions: Events are logged asynchronously with minimal metadata; no personally identifiable information is stored.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When event frequency exceeds threshold, triggers rate-limiting or sampling mechanism.

layer2.mapping: Each logged event E(P,T,F) corresponds to a point in a probabilistic phase space where P represents a latent user type and F encodes behavioral intent.
layer2.telemetry: Number of unique events per session, average time between events

primitives.name: Autonomous Operational Learning
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Why It Matters This increases GSE's ability to operate autonomously, learn from users, improve conversion, reduce SaaS cost, and make product/marketing decisions from evidence.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'L': 'Learning rate (dimensionless)', 'U': 'User engagement score (normalized)', 'C': 'Conversion probability (probability)', 'S': 'System state vector (vector of dimension d)'}
primitives.assumptions: Learning dynamics follow a stochastic gradient descent process with bounded convergence.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When U < threshold, model retraining is triggered via active learning.

layer2.mapping: The kernel function K(S_i, S_j) = exp(-||S_i - S_j||^2 / σ^2) defines similarity between system states, enabling nonparametric regression of C(U) over U.
layer2.telemetry: Change in conversion rate over rolling window, entropy of user segments

primitives.name: Trustworthy Product Experience
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## User-Facing Value Customers get a clearer, faster, more personalized, more trustworthy product experience.
primitives.assumptions: Experience quality metrics are jointly optimized through multi-objective reinforcement learning.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When T < threshold, adaptive UI components are deployed to increase transparency.

layer2.mapping: The trust signal T is derived from a weighted sum of A, P, and R, where weights are learned from user feedback loops.
layer2.telemetry: Average response time, accessibility compliance score, personalization hit rate
